messages.author: c1ef9a97cbbb91f5
messages.subject: Decreasingly ordered vector data type
parts:
How do I declare a vector whose elements are positive and decreasingly ordered, e.g., v = [5, 4, 3, 2, 1]? 

I can do the following using the ordered_positive data type and transform it to decreasing order. But I wonder if there is a built-in data type for that? Thanks.

parameters{
ordered_positve[5] v;
}

transformed parameters{
real v2[5];
for (i in 1:5){
v2[i] = v[5 - i +1]
}

}

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Decreasingly ordered vector data type
parts:
I'm afraid there's not a better way to do that. We should
have a reverse(vector) operation. You probably want

vector<lower=0>[5] v;

or

real<lower=0> v[5];

just to declare your intention that the entries of v are
positive; making it a vector will support matrix operations.

- Bob
